caption:
You run your own business and manage your own search presence. Google released the Gemini Business Profile connection in June to help you edit your page directly in the chat. It replaces manual clicking with a simple conversation.

Open gemini.google.com on your desktop. Sign in with the personal account that manages your location. If the integration does not load automatically, type @Google Business Profile in the chat and follow the connection prompt. Review what it generates. Publish only when the details match your actual schedule.

This works if you are 18 or older and manage exactly one verified location. Google still reviews every change before it goes live on Search and Maps. The source notes that Google’s Calls metric counts click-throughs to call buttons, not confirmed conversations.

Save this reel so you can run the update next month.
